note: Tutorial summary page 1: SR Points and difficulty

blocks.text: ● Meet the condition set for each stage to earn +1 {o|SR Point}. Check the conditions with the {o|"Objectives"} general command.
● Earning an SR Point gives +10 PP to every allied pilot on the map.
● Your SR Point rate sets the next stage's difficulty. There are 2 ranks, {r|HARD} and {b|NORMAL}, and the current one is shown in the general commands.
• More enemies than on NORMAL, and stronger enemies may appear.
• Enemy machines and weapons get +3 upgrade levels.
• Battles pay 1.2x the funds of HARD.
Choose {o|"Beginner's Mode"} when you start the game to fix the difficulty at {b|NORMAL}. You also get an extra 20000 funds whenever you earn an SR Point.
